svg.text: Drawn from local repo + 10 Bottleneck Codex threads. Latest local boards read: 2026-06-26. Excalidraw MCP was not exposed, so this is a native .excalidraw scene file.
Decision discipline, operating loop hardening, SA mirroring, long-only policy.
Market-day windows, weekly sleeve rotation, weekend rebuild.
Dip, filing, SA exit/reduction, catalyst rules.
Provider symbol overrides and filing-source contracts.
Sleeve thesis library: power, compute, miners, memory/networking, semicap, optical, services, space, autonomy.
Ticker thesis, anti-thesis, hedge/sizing, invalidation, evidence quality.
Sentinel prefers state/latest_events over mock fallback.
dip_trigger, thesis_damage, filings, catalysts, hedge risk, SA exit/reduction, noise.
Active snapshot: 110 events; 108 high priority; 104 dip triggers.
Bounded-cause review: market/crowding, company-specific, financing, thesis damage, unknown.
Per-process run locks and run ledger.
Dirty worktree is not a stop condition unless writes conflict.
Blocks automation resume on live/source/position gaps.
Reads watchlist + asset/decision frontmatter + active signals.
- BUY_NOW requires thesis, valuation, sizing, anti-thesis, hedge, invalidation
- ADD_ON_DIP requires bounded cause, approved dip protocol, improved valuation, no thesis damage
- SELL requires named broken thesis or unacceptable risk
- reported puts stay signal-only / no shorts
Do not label adjacent proxies as current holdings.
Clean expression, scarcity, valuation, promotion discipline, max-add sizing.
Maps tracked universe onto Jensen five-layer AI stack: energy, chips, infrastructure, models/platforms, applications.

Compact current action surface: actions, source gaps, dip-cause reviews, high-priority signals.
Interactive five-layer map with local Update button via bcap value-chain --serve.
Needs concise actions, thesis decisions, unresolved signals, watch items, and validation gaps.
No generic research without a decision.
Uses live-check for sentinel windows and daily-board for close board.
No scheduled loop; lead with actions and unresolved events.

CEG heartbeat, IREN education, MU material event review, TSM starter-buy search.
Built reports/value_chain_visualizer.html and local Update server mode.
Committed live-ops/readiness work and opened draft PR #4.
Read all Bottleneck threads surfaced by app + repo; writes this Excalidraw artifact only.
Latest board: 2026-06-26. Worktree already dirty; preserve unrelated research/state changes.
user questions and scheduled wakes feed Codex threads

Decision files currently reflect active-signal pressure: most names are RESEARCH_REQUIRED until dip causes and material events are reviewed or resolved append-only. Asset frontmatter still carries baseline house views, including one older BUY_NOW baseline, so the board/decision engine is the operational truth surface.
Validation rule of thumb: after process/universe changes run bcap validate; before resuming market-day automation run bcap validate --strict-live or bcap resume-check.
